name: navigable-grid
title: Navigable grid
description: A table with the spreadsheet keyboard model: arrow keys between cells, Home and End along a row, one cell in the tab order, and Enter to reach the controls inside.
docs: Give it columns and rows and name it with a caption or an aria-label. The grid is one Tab stop: arrows move one cell, Home and End go to the ends of the row, Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End to the corners, PageUp and PageDown by a screenful. Buttons, checkboxes and inputs in cells leave the Tab order until you press Enter or F2 on their cell; Escape hands the focus back, and Tab walks that cell's controls and then leaves the grid. Mark the column that names the row with rowHeader, read where the person is from onCellFocus, and hide columns with CSS if you like: the keyboard steps over them. Keep columns the same array between renders and moving the cursor redraws two rows, not all of them.
